title: Identify the fastest lap time ever recorded at any Italian Grand Prix by a
question: Identify the fastest lap time ever recorded at any Italian Grand Prix by a German driver born between 1970 and 1990. Return only the lap time in its original format.

prediction.sql:
WITH flt AS (
  SELECT r.XCL_088 AS lap,
         (CAST(SUBSTRING(r.XCL_088,1,INSTR(r.XCL_088,':')-1) AS REAL)*60)
         + (CAST(SUBSTRING(r.XCL_088,INSTR(r.XCL_088,':')+1,INSTR(r.XCL_088,'.')-INSTR(r.XCL_088,':')-1) AS REAL))
         + (CAST(SUBSTRING(r.XCL_088,INSTR(r.XCL_088,'.')+1) AS REAL)/1000) AS secs
  FROM results r
  JOIN races rc ON r.XCL_074 = rc.XCL_065
  JOIN drivers d ON r.XCL_075 = d.XCL_034
  WHERE rc.XCL_069 = 'Italian Grand Prix'
    AND d.XCL_041 = 'German'
    AND STRFTIME('%Y', d.XCL_040) BETWEEN '1970' AND '1990'
    AND r.XCL_088 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT lap FROM flt ORDER BY secs ASC LIMIT 1
